description: Source code implementing transition and timing logic for Bluetooth Mesh lighting models, including functions for calculating remaining time, setting transition values, and handling timers and work handlers for various lighting states.

methods.name: calculate_rt
methods.description: Calculates the remaining time for a transition based on current timestamp and total duration.

methods.name: set_transition_counter
methods.description: Sets the total duration and counter for a transition based on the transition time.

methods.name: set_transition_values
methods.description: Sets transition parameters such as delta values for different lighting states based on transition type.

methods.name: onoff_handler
methods.description: Handles OnOff transition timer events, updating light state accordingly.

methods.name: level_lightness_handler
methods.description: Handles Lightness level transition timer events, updating current lightness.

methods.name: level_temp_handler
methods.description: Handles Temperature level transition timer events, updating current temperature.

methods.name: light_lightness_actual_handler
methods.description: Handles actual lightness transition timer events.

methods.name: light_lightness_linear_handler
methods.description: Handles linear lightness transition timer events.

methods.name: light_ctl_handler
methods.description: Handles CTL (Color Temperature and Lightness) transition timer events.

methods.name: light_ctl_temp_handler
methods.description: Handles CTL temperature transition timer events.
